overrides.reason: ZGGSVP3 hands its LWORK to ZGEQP3, which picks its block size from LWORK and falls back to the unblocked ZLAQP2 when the workspace is short of (N+1)*NB. The blocked and unblocked column-pivoted QR update the column norms differently, so where two candidate columns are nearly tied they can pivot differently, and A, B, U, V, Q (and the pivots in IWORK) then hold a different, equally valid reduction U^H*A*Q, V^H*B*Q. K and L do not depend on LWORK; the module's tests check the reduction at the minimum WORK past the blocking threshold by residual (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: the triangular reduction of A depends on ZGEQP3's pivot order, which LWORK's block size can change in near ties
set.params.B.workDependent: the triangular reduction of B depends on ZGEQP3's pivot order, which LWORK's block size can change in near ties
set.params.U.workDependent: U follows the pivot order that LWORK's block size can change
set.params.V.workDependent: V follows the pivot order that LWORK's block size can change
set.params.Q.workDependent: Q follows the pivot order that LWORK's block size can change
set.params.IWORK.workDependent: the pivots LWORK's block size can change in near ties
set.params.TAU.workDependent: scratch reflector scalars of the pivoted factorizations
